title: Engagement 1: Internal Digital Ecosystem Audit (Dry Run)
notes: This is not a client engagement, not a public case study, not proof of commercial delivery, and not a public offer activation.
No pricing, contact, intake, contract, data collection, conversion, checkout, infrastructure, or external-platform change was made or authorized.

allowedEvidence: existing local publicly shippable strings and output behavior

topFiveStrengths: Public-output guard verified effective against every tested exposure pattern (F-012)
Lifecycle-gating discipline (isLiveProperty, VERIFIED_INBOXES, HELD_PENDING_CONFIRMATION) consistently applied and confirmed working
Extensive, dated, cross-referenced documentation across Marks 1-17 enabled precise finding evidence
104/104 unit tests, 0/15 routes a11y violations, 0 build-guard violations both PUBLIC_PREVIEW modes
Audit-phase methodology transferred cleanly onto this dry run without requiring invention
topFiveBlockers: F-001: GitHub Pages/CNAME deployment-target conflict, unresolved since Mark 2.1
F-002: legacy/index.html unverified contact/social claims outside dist-scoped guard coverage
F-003: no engagement-scope agreement template exists
F-004: contact-intake Worker rate limiting fails open without KV provisioning

findings.title: CNAME / GitHub Pages deployment-target conflict remains unresolved
findings.riskStatement: A CNAME file ships in every dist/ build; if GitHub Pages is ever enabled for this repository (state unknown), it could serve this repository in parallel with or instead of the intended Cloudflare Pages deployment.
findings.recommendation: Owner confirms GitHub Pages Settings -> Pages source directly, then removes public/CNAME or documents a deliberate dual-target design.
findings.publicUseImpact: Could affect which content is actually served at texasmovement.com, independent of this repository's own guards.
findings.validationCondition: Resolved when owner confirms GitHub Pages state and either removes public/CNAME or documents why it's intentionally retained.
findings.explicitNonAction: This audit did not check, change, or query GitHub Pages settings, DNS records, or Cloudflare configuration.

findings.title: legacy/index.html carries unverified contact/social claims outside the build-output guard's direct scan scope
findings.riskStatement: check-public-output.mjs scans only dist/; legacy/index.html is not part of the Astro build and is never copied into dist/, so its unverified email, unconfirmed LinkedIn URL, and FounderLink-as-active-intake framing would ship unvetted if this file were ever served directly.
findings.recommendation: Owner decides whether current deployment-target-discipline mitigation is sufficient, or whether an explicit safeguard (deploy-exclusion check or relocation) is warranted.
findings.publicUseImpact: Would present an unverified email as a working contact point and an unconfirmed LinkedIn URL as confirmed, if ever exposed.
findings.validationCondition: Resolved when the owner's decision is implemented and verified.
findings.explicitNonAction: This audit did not modify, remove, or relocate legacy/index.html, and did not extract or use its content beyond citing it as evidence.

findings.title: Flagship commercial framework has zero populated evidence; Engagement 1 is its first real exercise
findings.riskStatement: No engagement-scope agreement template exists; Engagement 2 cannot begin under documented conditions until this gap closes.
findings.recommendation: Owner or a future authorized task drafts an engagement-scope agreement template.
findings.publicUseImpact: None directly - internal process readiness only.
findings.validationCondition: Resolved when a reviewed template exists.
findings.explicitNonAction: This audit did not draft a contract or agreement template.

findings.title: Rate limiting on the contact-intake Worker fails open by design, undeployed
findings.riskStatement: If PUBLIC_CONTACT_ENDPOINT is ever set without first provisioning the KV namespace, the deployed Worker will accept unlimited requests per IP.
findings.recommendation: Provision RATE_LIMIT_KV in the same deployment step that ever sets PUBLIC_CONTACT_ENDPOINT to a real value.
findings.publicUseImpact: None currently - the endpoint is inert.
findings.validationCondition: Resolved when RATE_LIMIT_KV is bound before or at the same time as PUBLIC_CONTACT_ENDPOINT activation.
findings.explicitNonAction: This audit did not deploy the Worker, provision KV, or set any environment variable.

findings.title: Unoptimized/potentially-unreferenced large image assets inflate build weight
findings.riskStatement: If assets are unreferenced they inflate deploy size for no benefit; if referenced but unoptimized they could affect LCP.
findings.recommendation: A future task cross-references every public/*.png against actual usage, then compresses or removes accordingly.
findings.publicUseImpact: Could affect real-world page-load performance once deployed.
findings.validationCondition: Resolved when a follow-up task confirms asset-to-usage mapping and optimizes or removes unreferenced files.
findings.explicitNonAction: No image was compressed, removed, or modified in this audit.

findings.title: docs/pr-screenshots/ is a self-documented, orphaned review artifact
findings.riskStatement: None - purely repository hygiene; the directory's own README marks it disposable and its stated deletion condition (PR merged) has been met.
findings.recommendation: Owner or a future cleanup task deletes the directory.
findings.publicUseImpact: None - never part of any build output.
findings.validationCondition: Resolved when removed or explicitly retained by owner choice.
findings.explicitNonAction: This audit did not delete this directory.

findings.title: src/lib/site.ts:273 hardcodes an email string inline rather than sourcing from @tmi/constants
findings.riskStatement: Functionally inert today (gated by empty VERIFIED_INBOXES); purely architectural-consistency drift.
findings.recommendation: Move the literal string into a constants file, imported by site.ts.
findings.validationCondition: Resolved when check:constants's drift-warning count no longer includes this line.
findings.explicitNonAction: This audit did not modify site.ts.

findings.title: 8 unconfirmed (TBD) org/social facts remain, tracked but still open

findings.recommendation: No code action - awaiting owner-supplied facts.

findings.title: No automated WCAG 2.2 conformance evaluation exists; only axe-core's WCAG 2.1 rule subset
findings.riskStatement: 0 violations found under the existing rule set is not the same claim as WCAG 2.2 conformance.
findings.recommendation: If a WCAG 2.2 conformance claim is ever desired, run a manual WCAG-EM evaluation rather than assuming the current rule set covers it.
findings.publicUseImpact: No current public claim exists to correct; preventive finding.
findings.validationCondition: Not applicable unless a conformance claim is proposed.
findings.explicitNonAction: No new accessibility rule set or tool was added.

findings.recommendation: Use the manual DevTools method already documented in Mark 17 when a real measurement is next needed.
findings.explicitNonAction: No tool was installed this session.
